cover_letter_text:
Hello,

I am writing to ask whether Langtree Consulting has room for a junior civil drafter. Your careers page says that whether you are a graduate seeking to thrive on opportunity or a more senior professional, you can enjoy a career in a relaxed and supportive culture.

In February 2026 I completed the Advanced Diploma of Civil Construction Design, where I designed and documented road geometry, earthworks, pavement systems and stormwater drainage, and prepared and reviewed technical drawings in AutoCAD and Civil 3D, applying Australian Standards. I also hold a Bachelor of Science in Civil Engineering (Philippines, 2019), and on site there from 2019 to 2020 I reviewed drawings and carried out site inspections and quality checks.

I am based in Melton VIC. I will relocate to Townsville for this role and can start two weeks after an offer. Full working rights in Australia (Subclass 485 visa), no sponsorship needed. Could we arrange a call?

Marc Masarate
